Class ClientEyeRuntime

java.lang.Object
com.github.crittscott.somegoogly.client.ClientEyeRuntime
public final class ClientEyeRuntime extends Object
Loader-neutral owner of mob, boat, placed-head, and framed-item eye simulations and their lifecycle.

    • tick

      public static void tick(@Nullable net.minecraft.world.level.Level level, boolean simulate)
      Advance the tick counter, evict any tracker idle past EVICT_IDLE_TICKS, and step the physics of those rendered this tick or last when simulate is true. The client lifecycle disables simulation while there is no level or the game is paused. A head's eyes are also dropped when its eye state has changed, to be rebuilt from the new state when it next renders.

    • tickBehaviors

      public static void tickBehaviors()
      Advance received expression time once per unpaused simulation tick, even for unrendered entities.
